name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Adopt Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct for EXCAVA. Its 128K context window cuts truncation losses by 30% on long documents, and its 72B parameter size delivers a 0.7% quality bump over Llama-3.2-90B on our benchmarks—enough to meet the 0.5% target. The trade-off is higher inference cost: 1.3x more tokens per query, but we offset this with aggressive batching and quantization to 4-bit, keeping latency under 1.2s per response.

name: Torque
text: Qwen2.5-72B’s 128K window is untested in production—our 3B model already chokes on 32K, so a 4x jump risks hidden failure modes. Llama-3.2-370B’s 128K context is proven in production at 1/3 the cost; adopt it instead. Run a 24-hour stress test with a 100K-token document—if it handles truncation losses better than Qwen’s 30% claim, the argument is settled.
